scope: Exploratory reference construction/identifiability study, not a frozen prediction benchmark or enrollment.
selection: All20pH7temperature/buffer cells:70,80,90,97,110C x25,50,75,150mM. Retain the19measured runs, all timepoints/standards and the source-declared missing25mM110C cell. No selection by ratio, model prediction or residual.
prior_exposure: Published summaryKvalues and source images were inspected in previous source curation; tentative mass-balance concerns were noticed. No blinded confirmatory claim. MetaG/dGbyG predictions/errors on these experimental equilibria have not been computed or consulted.

extraction.method: Coordinate-bound PDF OCR tokens, image comparison and explicit correction ledger. Never infer a missing cell from adjacent conditions. Retain original tokens and coordinates.
extraction.calibration: Per-run external-standard concentration = sample peakarea / standard peakarea * standard concentration. Confirm the source method; retain ambiguity if not authenticated.
checks: Every numerical token assigned to a table/run/row/column or explicitly retained as unresolved.
All time values ordered and all supplied cis/trans observations paired.
Use source images to verify/correct OCR; every correction needs a cell and image locator.
Keep raw areas and calibrants; do not substitute fitted values or discard inconvenient timepoints.

model.primary: Closed reversible two-state model at each measured condition. Fit cis(t)=Ceq+(Cis0-Ceq)exp(-lambda*t), trans(t)=Ctotal-cis(t). UnknownsCtotal,Cis0,Ceq,lambda; constrain positive total/rate and cis fractions in[0,1]. K=Ceq/(Ctotal-Ceq).
model.weighting: Initial equal concentration-unit residual weights on both channels are a declared working noise assumption. They are not source-calibrated measurement variances.
diagnostics: Report measured totalconcentration drift and both channel residuals at every condition.
Report residual cross-channel correlation and time trends; no formal significance claim from posthoc diagnostics.
Fit cis/trans separately as sensitivity checks; materially incompatible asymptotes or mass balance prevent adopting a combined reference.
Do not replace the closed model with an arbitrary better-fitting model and call its asymptote a thermodynamic equilibrium.
model.identifiability: Profile K on a fixed log10 grid[-3,1] and reoptimize nuisance parameters. A working-iidGaussian profile threshold, if shown, is conditional and not an authenticated experimental confidence interval. Preserve flat/boundary profiles.
model.temperature_transfer: No298.15K target automatically follows. First resolve native pH(T), activity/speciation conventions, model adequacy and covariance; any extrapolation needs a separate uncertainty construction.
